svg.text: One bundle carries most of it. Same synthetic data throughout — a new forecast every 3 h, each reaching 24 h ahead.
The data is a field, not a series
Every cell is one forecast: what was said at an issue time about a valid time.
D — every row at once is the bundle below, and A and C are already inside it.
D — every issue at once (the field, drawn)
One line per forecast, paler the older it is. Where they fan apart is where successive forecasts disagreed.
its edge is stitched from 10 different
one query — ?valid_from=..;valid_to=.. — and A, B and C all fall out of it
free from the bundle over a short window
B — fix the valid time (a column)
“How did our view of one moment settle as it approached?”
The x axis is ISSUE time — a different domain, so this one needs its own chart.
issue time → (24 h before … the moment itself)
